The central figure is an adult with short shaved sides and longer hair gathered into a small topknot; a scar runs through the viewer-left eyebrow.
The figure wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and metal buckle detail, a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the hero panel, the figure stands upright with arms at the sides and head turned toward the viewer's left on a wet industrial walkway or rooftop at night.

The bottom close-ups show the face, the jacket collar with buckle hardware, grimy hands with visible knuckles, and worn black lace-up boots.

The color palette is dominated by black and charcoal, with cool blue-gray shadows and warm amber highlights.
